alias: HOME: Decrease lights level and color
description: Smoothly decreases light intensity (min 20%) and color temperature (min 2200K) every 10 minutes until 9:45 PM

data.value: {{ [20, (states('input_number.light_level') | float(99) - (((states('input_number.light_level') | float(99) - 20) / [1, (((today_at('21:45') - now()).total_seconds() / 600) | round(0, 'ceil') | int)] | max) | round(0))) | round(0)] | max }}

{{ [2200, ((states('input_number.lights_color') | float(4000) - (((states('input_number.lights_color') | float(4000) - 2200) / [1, (((today_at('21:45') - now()).total_seconds() / 600) | round(0, 'ceil') | int)] | max) / 50) | round(0) * 50) | int)] | max }}

until.value_template: {{ now() >= today_at('21:45') or (states('input_number.light_level') | float(0) <= 20 and states('input_number.lights_color') | float(0) <= 2200) }}
